text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait's border is in good hands, interior minister says during visit to northern border with Iraq.
- New industrial authority to develop and finance Kuwait projects to start operations in January, minister says.
- Kuwait's imports from Japan reached $623 million in 1995.

- American troops in Kuwait take new security measures around camp Doha. On Sunday the United States embassy in Kuwait urged American citizens to exercise particular caution in light of reported threats against U.S. interests.
- Kuwait University professor says he plans to sue fellow professor Ahmad al-Baghdadi for alleged blasphemy against Islam.
- Prime minister encourages young Kuwaitis to join the private sector.
